bg.$description: color used by the card component for background (MarsUI Dashboard masters bind Surface/special/light-s0_dark-s1: white light / Dark/900 dark; #f9f9fa is the nested media panel, so the old s1 value inverted the surface hierarchy).

fg.$description: color used by the card component for foreground.

border-color.$description: color used by the card component for border color (MarsUI Outline/base_em hairline — painted on large Chart cards; Dashboard_info leaves width 0, which stays the default via ki.card.border-width).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the card component for border width.

radius.$description: dimension used by the card component for radius (MarsUI card surfaces ride the big_component scale: Dashboard_info 400x128 binds radius_xs 16px; large Chart cards anchor radius_lg 28px).

elevation.$description: Card resting elevation: MarsUI elevation ramp level e1 (brief §5, drop 0/1/1/-0.5 in the scheme shadow color; replaces the migrated M2-era shadow).

gap.$description: dimension used by the card component for gap (MarsUI Dashboard_info/Chart rhythm between regions 12px; material3 keeps zero via its override).

media-padding.$description: dimension used by the card component for media padding (MarsUI Dashboard masters inset media panels 8px inline; material3 keeps full-bleed zero via its override).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the card component for the surface block padding (16px carried by the card surface itself so stacked region paddings no longer double to 32px; formalizes the fallback ki-card.css already consumes).

media-radius.$description: dimension used by the card component for slotted media corner radius (MarsUI nested media panel Radius/big_component/radius_sm 20px; formalizes the fallback ki-card.css already consumes).

header-padding.$description: dimension used by the card component for header padding.

body-padding.$description: dimension used by the card component for body padding.

footer-padding.$description: dimension used by the card component for footer padding.

bg-image.$description: Optional decorative image over the card background.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete card backdrop filter, off by default.

elevated-fg.$description: Text on the elevated card background.

elevated-shadow.$description: Resting shadow for an elevated card.

filled-fg.$description: Text on the filled card background.

outlined-bg.$description: Page-coloured background for an outlined card.

outlined-fg.$description: Text on the outlined card background.

outlined-border.$description: Boundary colour for an outlined card.

outlined-border-width.$description: Hairline width for an outlined card.

hover-shadow.$description: Hover shadow of a primary-action card.

hover-overlay.$description: Pointer hover state layer on a primary-action card.

title-family.$description: Family used for a clickable card title.

border-width.$description: --ki-card-border-width under more contrast: cards draw their edge.

border-color.$description: --ki-card-border-color under more contrast: an edge at 3:1 or more against the page.
